definitions: Used as a positive response to good news or information.
A very light state of sleep, almost awake.
A state of ignorance or inaction.
To be in a very light state of sleep, almost awake.

blocks.text: "Sweet Slumber" is a 1943 song written by Lucky Millinder, Al J. Neiburg and Henri Woode and recorded by Lucky Millinder and His Orchestra. The song, with vocals by Trevor Bacon, was successful on three charts. "Sweet Slumber" became Lucky Millinder's third number one on the Harlem Hit Parade and number fifteen on the pop charts. The song also peaked at number four on the Most Played Jukebox Hillbilly Records chart.
